opus.problem: The cited verse (Judges 16:3) does not name the city or say that enemies waited at the gate. Those details come from Judges 16:1-2, so the clue's setting is not supported by its reference.
Acts 8:26 covers only the angel sending Philip to the desert road. Meeting the Ethiopian official is in Acts 8:27, so part of the clue is not in the cited verse.
Amos 1:6 gives the charge of exiling a population to Edom, but the fire on the city's walls is in Amos 1:7, not the cited verse.
